title: Tech Note: A simple client timeout technique

historical_commentary.text: Automatic client timeout for inactive sessions remains a relevant concept in 4D Server environments for license management and security. The ON EVENT CALL approach described here was the standard technique in the v6 era. Modern 4D Server provides built-in session timeout mechanisms and more sophisticated process management, reducing the need for custom timeout code, but the underlying pattern of detecting user inactivity and closing idle clients is still applicable.
related_updates: Modern 4D Server includes built-in client session management and timeout capabilities
4D v18+ introduced more granular session and process management features
ON EVENT CALL is still available but less commonly used for this purpose in modern architectures
